messages:
maria_cs: Hey team — spinning up Vanguard's dedicated pool this week. Quick census: quota requested = 6 A100s reserved, expected steady QPS ~12k, peak ~60k (burst windows). Need ops + eng to sign off on autoscale windows and priming plan. Renewal flagged as sensitive; if onboarding slips they mentioned potential price pushback. Ping @pranav_ops @eli_eng @sophia_se

pranav_ops: On it. Can we break the peak into two 30-min bursts instead of one 2h? that helps the autoscaler and reduces sustained memory pressure.

eli_eng: 2h bursts push KV retention and GPU memory. prefer shorter bursts. Also need confirmation on model variant & quantization for priming — which model are they serving?

maria_cs: They want redwood/guan-13b-int8 (customer tuned). They'll rely on persistent KV caching per session for latency-sensitive flows.

sophia_se: Noted. I'll set up an enablement session for their infra + SRE tomorrow 10:00 AM PT. Will demo cache priming, scaling knobs, and the load script.

jamie_cust: (jamie_cust) we prefer midday and evening windows. Midday 11:30–12:00, evening 18:30–19:00. Is that workable?

pranav_ops: Workable. Proposing autoscaler params: min_replicas=3, max_replicas=24, scale_step=2, stabilization_window=60s. That should smooth bursts while still reacting. I'll draft the HPA YAML.

eli_eng: Add a fallback routing policy: route to redwood/guan-7b-fp16 when mem_pressure > 85% OR P95 latency > 850ms sustained for 5m. Also enable prefix KV priming so cold starts are less painful.

maria_cs: Important: renewal committee set target SLO P95 <= 500ms. If we exceed that during onboarding the customer will escalate on pricing/commitment. We need strict mitigations.

nisha_pm: I'll record acceptance criteria in the playbook: functional (endpoints smoke), perf (P95 <= 500ms under validated profile), and billing (quota & metered expectations). Draft link: https://redwood.docs/wikis/onboard/vanguard-acceptance — please confirm edits.

warmup-bot: scheduled warmup-run at 1733333400; command: `/warmup run --profile=vanguard-prime --duration=20m --cache-prime`

pranav_ops: Warmup scheduled — for load tests use this shaping snippet (we'll run from two regions):
```bash
wrk2 -t8 -c400 -d30m -R 12000 --latency http://staging-dedicated/vanguard/generate
```
This approximates steady 12k RPS with bursts simulated via client-side ramp.

eli_eng: We'll tag traces with `vanguard-warmup` and enable per-route sampling in Console so SRE + CS can see tail latency by model variant. I'll push the instrumentation by EOD.

sophia_se: Enablement invite sent. I'll run through warmup steps live and capture screen recording. Also added a short customer feedback form to post after the warmup so we can capture friction points for the renewal committee.

maria_cs: Good. Action items recap: 1) @pranav_ops post HPA YAML + warmup traffic plan by EOD; 2) @eli_eng add fallback routing + tracing tags; 3) @sophia_se run enablement + record; 4) @nisha_pm update playbook and acceptance criteria; 5) customer (jamie_cust) confirm burst windows. I'll circle back in 24h. :thumbsup:

jamie_cust: Thanks — we'll confirm the windows and be on standby tomorrow. Appreciate the clear runbook.
